features.quote: Set max_turns to 15. Below 10 you may not reach Phase 2 on lower-ETR tasks. Above 20 the cost-per-run increases substantially with diminishing signal return.
features.justification_quote: cost-per-run increases substantially with diminishing signal return

features.quote: Exception: Task 5 (Async Phantom) benefits from max_turns=20 because the intermittent success stretches the cycle
